findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, so the test can pass without ever exercising the race
findings.body: In createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti, the background thread that repeatedly calls managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...) is started but never joined. The main thread deletes the 100 groups, sets deletedAll=true, and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty. Because there is no thread.join() (and no guarantee the reader thread has executed even a single iteration before the deletes finish), the test can pass vacuously on a slow or busy CI runner without ever reproducing the concurrent read-during-delete scenario this PR is fixing. Additionally, the reader thread performs one more iteration after deletedAll becomes true (the flag is only checked at the top of the loop), so any exception thrown in that final in-flight request happens after the assertion has already executed and is silently lost. The test should join the reader thread before asserting (and ideally ensure a minimum number of read iterations occurred).

findings.title: Fix only covers getSubGroupsCount; other cached read paths still NPE on concurrent group deletion
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() now null-checks modelSupplier.get() before use, but the identical concurrent-delete race remains in the sibling read paths of the same adapter: getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer), getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer), and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) (lines 254-269) all call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check, and getAttributes/getFirstAttribute go through cached lazy loaders that dereference the supplied GroupModel. If the group is deleted from the database between cache read and delegate load, those paths still throw the same NullPointerException this PR set out to fix, so requests hitting them (e.g. paginated subgroup listing while a group is removed) remain broken. The behavior is also now inconsistent: when the adapter was invalidated, isUpdated() throws IllegalStateException("Not found in database") for a deleted group, while this method silently returns null for the same condition.
